item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a 2024 source showing Scholz or close family receiving assets, contracts, monopolies, gifts, bribes, emoluments, or benefits through an opaque foundation. The record is mostly about allegations and transparency problems, especially Cum-Ex/Warburg, not an adjudicated enrichment case. On this evidence, `7B.4` is best treated as **not proven / weakly negative**, not affirmative.","evidence":[{"title":"Änderung des Lobbyregistergesetzes in Kraft","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"2024-03-01","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/parlament/lobbyregister/pm-240301-nl-992030","summary":"The 2024 lobby-register changes expanded disclosure on concrete rulemaking, financing sources, and revolving-door ties, which is evidence against hidden influence operating unchecked around Scholz’s government.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.2","7B.3"]},{"title":"Exekutiver Fußabdruck beschlossen: Nur eine Minimallösung","publisher":"Transparency International Deutschland","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.transparency.de/aktuelles/detail/article/exekutiver-fussabdruck-nur-eine-minimalloesung","summary":"Civil-society critics said the new executive-footprint rule was only a minimal transparency fix, which is a cautionary note about incomplete anti-capture safeguards rather than proof of profiteering.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.2","7B.3"]},{"title":"Strafanzeigen gegen Mitglieder der Bundesregierung","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"2024-07-31","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1014366","summary":"Several criminal complaints against Scholz did not lead to investigations because prosecutors found no sufficient factual grounds, which undercuts claims of proven criminal self-dealing in 2024.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.1"]},{"title":"Cum-Ex-Untersuchungsausschuss: Scholz weist weiterhin jede Einflussnahme zurück","publisher":"tagesschau.de","date":"2024-12-06","url":"https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/innenpolitik/scholz-cum-ex-ausschuss-100.html","summary":"Scholz again denied political influence over Warburg and HSH Nordbank; the report says no proof of influence emerged, but it also records persistent “memory gap” criticism and a lingering proximity-to-bankers cloud.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"Streit um Cum-ex-Ausschuss: Kanzleramt muss geheimes Rechtsgutachten offenlegen","publisher":"Tagesspiegel","date":"2024-02-16","url":"https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/streit-um-cum-ex-untersuchungsausschuss-kanzleramt-muss-geheimes-rechtsgutachten-offenlegen-11215801.html","summary":"Reporting suggested the Chancellor’s Office had an internal legal memo aimed at blunting the CDU push for a Bundestag inquiry into the Warburg affair, which is relevant as a possible effort to contain scrutiny around a conflict-of-interest allegation.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.2"]},{"title":"Bericht: Regierung vertagt Entscheidung über strengere Vorschriften im 5G-Netz","publisher":"Reuters via onvista","date":"2024-05-23","url":"https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293","summary":"Sensitive 5G-security decisions were handled in confidential interministerial talks and ministries declined public comment, which is a transparency weak point around a major regulatory file, though not proof of personal gain.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.2"]}]}
